lines: Your teacher tells you that they are meeting two of their childhood
friends this evening. One is 5 feet tall and the other is 6 feet tall. What is
your guess as to each friend’s gender based on this information?
You might have guessed that the 5-foot-tall person is a woman and
the 6-foot-tall person is a man. There is a chance that you are wrong. But
experience tells us that 5-foot-tall men and 6-foot-tall women are rare.
We have seen that, more often, men are taller than women.
